mcq.q: Isukuti is a lively drum dance of the
mcq.explanation: Isukuti is played by the Luhya people, especially the Isukha and Idakho.

mcq.q: What is the job of the ropes on a drum?
mcq.explanation: Ropes or lacing keep the skin stretched tight.

mcq.q: Which is a melodic percussion instrument?
mcq.explanation: A xylophone has bars that give different notes, so it can play a tune.

mcq.q: A thumb piano produces sound when you
options: pluck its metal tongues with your thumbs
hit it with a big stick
mcq.explanation: The kalimba or mbira has metal tongues that you pluck with the thumbs.

mcq.q: Who must do the burning when making charcoal sticks?
mcq.explanation: Fire is dangerous, so only an adult does the burning.

mcq.q: In art, tone or value means
options: how light or dark something is
mcq.explanation: Tone is the lightness or darkness of a colour or shading.

mcq.q: How can you make the brightest part of a charcoal drawing?
options: Leave the paper white or lift charcoal with a clean eraser
mcq.explanation: The brightest parts have little or no charcoal.

mcq.q: A full netball court is divided into how many equal parts?
mcq.explanation: A netball court is divided into three equal thirds.

mcq.q: What do the letters WA stand for?
mcq.explanation: WA is the Wing Attack, who feeds the shooters.

mcq.q: What does pivoting mean?
options: Turning on the landing foot without moving it
mcq.explanation: A player keeps one foot down and turns on it.

mcq.q: Who stops the game with a whistle for a rule break?
mcq.explanation: Umpires control the game and blow the whistle.

mcq.q: In a chest pass your thumbs turn downwards
mcq.explanation: Thumbs turn down as the arms straighten and the ball leaves the hands.

mcq.q: The basic knot for the macramé ball is the
mcq.explanation: The learner uses overhand knots to make the net around the core.

mcq.q: How should a good netball player treat the other team at the end?
mcq.explanation: Fair play means being respectful whether you win or lose.

mcq.q: Red mixed with yellow makes
mcq.explanation: Red and yellow together give orange.

mcq.q: On the colour wheel, green sits between
mcq.explanation: Green sits between the two primary colours that make it.

mcq.q: A lighter tone of a colour is called a
mcq.explanation: Adding white makes a tint.

mcq.q: To paint an object so it looks round, you should
options: paint a lighter tone on the lit side and a darker tone on the shadow side
mcq.explanation: Tones make an object look solid and round.

mcq.q: After painting, how should you store a brush?
options: Standing on its hairs in water
Washed and laid flat or with hairs upwards
mcq.explanation: Washing and shaping the tip keeps the brush in good shape.

mcq.q: Which pieces should be pasted first in a montage?
mcq.explanation: You paste the back ones first and then those in front.

mcq.q: Why should you take turns to talk about each other's work?
mcq.explanation: Taking turns shows respect and love for others.

mcq.q: The steady pulse in a piece of music is called the
mcq.explanation: The beat is the steady pulse we tap or clap along to.

mcq.q: How long does one quaver last?
options: A quarter of a beat only
mcq.explanation: A quaver is half a beat.

mcq.q: How long does a crotchet rest last?
mcq.explanation: A crotchet rest is one beat of silence.

mcq.q: Which pattern has three beats of sound and one beat of silence?
mcq.explanation: Only the first has a single rest and three sounding beats.

mcq.q: Which letter has an ascender?
mcq.explanation: The letter t is a tall letter, with a stem that rises above small letters.

mcq.q: How many guide lines are used for practising lettering in this lesson?
mcq.explanation: Ascender line, top of small letters, baseline and descender line make four.

mcq.q: Which of these four-beat patterns ends on a long note?
mcq.explanation: Only the first ends on a crotchet (taa).

mcq.q: A monotone line in music writing is
options: a single line on which notes are written
mcq.explanation: On a monotone we write the rhythm on one line.

mcq.q: The sol-fa syllable m is pronounced
mcq.explanation: The syllable m is me.

mcq.q: The Kodaly hand sign for d is
mcq.explanation: Doh is shown with a fist.

mcq.q: Which nationality was Zoltan Kodaly, whose method uses hand signs?
mcq.explanation: Zoltan Kodaly was a Hungarian music teacher.

mcq.q: Which move skips over a note?
mcq.explanation: Going from d to m skips r.

mcq.q: In the worked melody of this lesson, the last note is
mcq.explanation: The final note is d, on a crotchet.

mcq.q: A slab of clay is
mcq.explanation: A slab is a flat sheet of clay.

mcq.q: Why should clay models dry slowly in the shade?
options: Fast drying in strong sun can crack them
mcq.explanation: Slow drying prevents cracks.

mcq.q: Which is part of a good warm-up?
mcq.explanation: Jogging and stretching prepare the body.

mcq.q: In an elongated start, the rear knee is level with
options: the toes of the front foot
the heel of the front foot
mcq.explanation: The elongated start puts the knee further back, by the heel of the front foot.

mcq.q: Which foot is usually placed in front at the start?
options: The stronger foot, used to kick a ball
mcq.explanation: The stronger foot is the front foot.

mcq.q: Leaning far backwards while sprinting will
options: slow you down like a brake
mcq.explanation: Leaning back acts like a brake.

mcq.q: The top stripe of the Kenyan flag is
mcq.explanation: Black is at the top, red in the middle and green at the bottom.

mcq.q: On the Kenyan flag, green stands for
mcq.explanation: Green stands for the land and its natural wealth.

mcq.q: How should we treat the national flag?
options: With care and respect, never letting it touch the ground
mcq.explanation: Respect for the flag means caring for it.

mcq.q: A roll in gymnastics is
options: a movement in which the body turns over along the floor
mcq.explanation: A roll turns the body over along the mat.

mcq.q: How long should you hold a crab balance in this lesson?
mcq.explanation: Hold the balance for three to five slow counts.

mcq.q: In a side roll, your body should be
options: straight and long like a log
mcq.explanation: A straight, tight body rolls smoothly.

mcq.q: Which is a safe surface for gymnastics?
options: A mat or soft clean ground
mcq.explanation: Soft, flat surfaces prevent injuries.

mcq.q: A sequence in gymnastics is
options: a set of movements performed in a fixed order
mcq.explanation: A sequence links skills one after the other.

mcq.q: Which health benefit comes from gymnastics?
mcq.explanation: Stretching and rolling help joints and muscles bend freely.

mcq.q: In a partner check for the crab balance, how many touching points does the table have?
mcq.explanation: The table has four legs, two hands and two feet.

mcq.q: A sacred song is
options: a song about a football match
mcq.explanation: Sacred songs praise God, give thanks or teach faith.

mcq.q: The message of a song is
options: the main idea the singers want us to hear
mcq.explanation: Message is the main idea.

mcq.q: In music, the sign p means
mcq.explanation: The letter p stands for soft.

mcq.q: Singing softly at the end of a lullaby shows
mcq.explanation: Softness is dynamics.

mcq.q: Which facial expression fits a joyful song?
mcq.explanation: Facial expressions show the mood.

mcq.q: The East African Community is
options: a group of countries in East Africa that work together
mcq.explanation: The community brings countries together to cooperate.

mcq.q: Which folk songs welcome a new baby?
mcq.explanation: Naming songs are sung when a baby is named.

mcq.q: Why should you sing folk songs from other communities with respect?
options: They are part of our shared culture
mcq.explanation: Respect helps unity and cultural appreciation.

mcq.q: Which is used only for taking photographs?
mcq.explanation: A digital camera is made for photography.

mcq.q: The flash is
options: a small light for dark places
mcq.explanation: The flash gives extra light.

mcq.q: What should you do before photographing someone?
mcq.explanation: Permission is polite and safe.

mcq.q: Early morning and late afternoon light is
mcq.explanation: These times give soft light.

mcq.q: A subject in photography is
options: the person or thing you photograph
mcq.explanation: The subject is what you are photographing.

mcq.q: To keep the camera steady you should
options: hold it with both hands and keep elbows near your body
hold it at arm's length with one finger
mcq.explanation: A steady hold gives a sharp photograph.

mcq.q: When you give feedback on a friend's photograph you should
options: say what you like first and then suggest one improvement
mcq.explanation: Kind and helpful feedback works best.

mcq.q: A descant recorder is made of
mcq.explanation: Recorders are commonly made of plastic or wood.

mcq.q: How many finger holes are on the front of the descant recorder?
mcq.explanation: There are seven on the front and one thumb hole at the back.

mcq.q: Which hand is at the top of the recorder?
mcq.explanation: The left hand is at the top and the right hand at the bottom.

mcq.q: A squeaky, very high sound usually means you are
mcq.explanation: Gentle air makes a good tone.

mcq.q: Why should you not use very hot water on a plastic recorder?
mcq.explanation: Heat can warp plastic.

mcq.q: Which note is played with the thumb and holes 1, 2 and 3 covered?
mcq.explanation: G adds the third hole.

mcq.q: On the staff, the note G sits on
mcq.explanation: G is on the second line from the bottom with the treble clef.

mcq.q: When you make a mistake while playing in a group, you should
mcq.explanation: Continue and rejoin.

mcq.q: Why should you not dive into shallow water?
options: You can hit the bottom and hurt your head or neck
mcq.explanation: Shallow water is dangerous for diving.

mcq.q: In the sit-and-slide entry, you first
options: sit on the edge with feet in the water
mcq.explanation: You sit, turn and slide in.

mcq.q: In bubble blowing, you blow bubbles
mcq.explanation: You put your mouth in the water and blow out slowly.

mcq.q: Which float has the body curled up like a ball?
mcq.explanation: The tucked body with the back at the surface is the mushroom float.

mcq.q: In a prone float, you keep your body
options: long and relaxed with face in the water
mcq.explanation: A long relaxed body floats better.

mcq.q: A streamlined shape is
options: long and thin like an arrow
mcq.explanation: A long shape slips easily through water.

mcq.q: If someone is drowning, the safest action for a child is to
options: shout for an adult and throw something that floats
mcq.explanation: Do not enter the water; get help and throw a floating object.

mcq.q: In the frog jump, you should land
mcq.explanation: Bent knees absorb the shock.

mcq.q: The snake slither is done
options: lying on the tummy and wriggling forward
mcq.explanation: The body moves side to side like a snake.

mcq.q: Monkey swing helps to develop
mcq.explanation: Moving side to side lightly needs balance.

mcq.q: In the hawk and the chicks game, the hen
options: chases the hawk away for ever
mcq.explanation: The hen blocks the hawk.

mcq.q: An elephant walk suits which rhythm?
options: Slow steady beats such as taa taa taa
mcq.explanation: Slow heavy steps.

mcq.q: Animal games improve
mcq.explanation: They strengthen muscles and improve stamina.

mcq.q: To appreciate a work of art means to
mcq.explanation: Appreciation is valuing with understanding.

mcq.q: Good feedback should be
mcq.explanation: Good feedback helps the person improve.

mcq.q: A display portfolio holds
mcq.explanation: It is for showing to others.

mcq.q: Why should you write the date on each work in your portfolio?
options: To show when it was made
mcq.explanation: Dates show how your skills grow.

mcq.q: The Kenya National Anthem is called
mcq.explanation: The Kiswahili title is Ee Mungu Nguvu Yetu.

mcq.q: On which occasion may the national anthem be sung?
mcq.explanation: It is sung on national days and at official events.

mcq.q: In a folk song, the soloist
mcq.explanation: The soloist starts or leads.

mcq.q: A good sportsperson
mcq.explanation: Fair play and respect.

short.q: Give one example of a melodic percussion instrument and one non-melodic percussion instrument.
short.answer: Melodic: xylophone. Non-melodic: shaker, kayamba or claves.

short.q: Give four safety rules when making charcoal sticks.
short.answer: An adult does the burning; keep far from the fire; leave the tin closed until cold; collect only dead twigs; wash hands afterwards. Any four.

short.q: Why is it important to appreciate the percussion instruments of different communities?
short.answer: They show the culture and skill of each community. They help us respect one another. They should be preserved for future generations.

short.q: Explain how the elongated start is different from the medium start.
short.answer: The rear knee is placed further back, level with the heel of the front foot. The feet are further apart. The push is longer and stronger but may feel less steady.
short.working: 1 mark for each valid difference or explanation, up to 4.

short.q: State what the colours black and green stand for on the Kenyan flag.
short.answer: Black stands for the people of Kenya. Green stands for the land and its natural wealth.

short.q: Why should the flag stick be held high while cheering?
short.answer: So it does not hit other people, and so the flag can be seen.

short.q: Give four steps of a double-handed catch.
short.answer: Watch the ball into your hands; reach out with both hands; spread the fingers with the thumbs close; bend the arms and pull the ball to the chest.

short.q: Give three safety measures to observe when playing netball.
short.answer: Remove jewellery, cut long nails, warm up, wear proper shoes, play on flat ground. Any three.

short.q: State three ways of showing fair play in a netball game.
short.answer: Follow the rules; respect the umpire; shake hands with the other team; take turns in positions; encourage teammates. Any three.

short.q: Explain how to make a tint of blue.
short.answer: Add white to blue, a little at a time, until it is as light as you want.
short.working: 1 mark for white, 1 mark for adding gradually.

short.q: What is a montage?
short.answer: A picture made by joining many cut pictures or pieces of material on a background.
short.working: 1 mark for many pieces, 1 mark for joined on a background.

short.q: Why should we take turns and respect others' views when talking about paintings and montages?
short.answer: It is fair, it shows respect and it helps everyone learn.

short.q: What is a rest in music?
short.answer: A sign for silence for a certain length of time.
short.working: 1 mark for silence, 1 mark for length of time.

short.q: Name four guide lines used for free hand lettering.
short.answer: Ascender line, top of small letters, baseline and descender line.

short.q: Why should a composed rhythm be your own idea?
short.answer: Copying is not fair and honest. Your own idea shows integrity and creativity.

short.q: What is stepwise motion? Give an example.
short.answer: Moving from a note to the next note above or below. For example, d to r.

short.q: Explain how to make a slab and a coil from clay.
short.answer: Flatten the clay with a rolling pin until even for a slab. Roll a small piece between palms for a coil.
short.working: 1 mark for the slab, 1 mark for the coil, 1 mark for even thickness.

short.q: What is a balance in gymnastics?
short.answer: A position held still for a few seconds under control.
short.working: 1 mark for still position, 1 mark for control or holding.

short.q: Why do we get up slowly after a side roll?
short.answer: Getting up fast can make you feel dizzy and you may fall. Slowly is safer.
short.working: 1 mark for dizziness, 1 mark for falling, 1 mark for safety.

short.q: Describe how partners should give feedback on each other's gymnastics.
short.answer: Watch carefully, say one good thing first, then one thing to improve, and be kind.

short.q: What is the difference between tempo and dynamics?
short.answer: Tempo is the speed of the music. Dynamics are how loud or soft the music is.

short.q: What does singing in unison mean? Why is it good for an anthem?
short.answer: Everyone sings the same notes at the same time. It is simple and everybody can join in together.
short.working: 1 mark for the meaning, 2 marks for the reason.

short.q: Describe the roles in a folk song performance.
short.answer: The soloist leads the song; the chorus answers or repeats; the instrumentalists play instruments to keep the beat; dancers move to the music.

short.q: Give three ways of caring for a digital camera.
short.answer: Hold with two hands; use a strap; clean the lens with a soft dry cloth; keep away from water and dust; charge the battery. Any three.

short.q: What is the centre of interest in a photograph?
short.answer: The main subject that you want the viewer to notice first, for example a friend's face or a flower.
short.working: 1 mark for main subject, 1 mark for noticed first, 1 mark for an example.

short.q: How should you give feedback on a friend's photograph?
short.answer: Say what you like first, comment on light and centre of interest, and suggest one improvement politely.

short.q: Why is it important not to share a recorder before cleaning it?
short.answer: Germs from the mouth can spread illnesses such as colds through the mouthpiece.
short.working: 1 mark for germs, 1 mark for the mouth or mouthpiece, 1 mark for spreading illness.

short.q: Why does a recorder squeak when you blow too hard?
short.answer: The air is blown too strongly, so the note jumps to a very high shrill sound. Blow more gently.

short.q: State four safety rules for the swimming pool.
short.answer: Swim only when watched; never swim alone; walk on the pool side; no pushing; no diving in shallow water; follow the whistle. Any four.

short.q: Describe how to do the mushroom float.
short.answer: In shallow water take a breath and put the face in. Bend the knees and hug them to the chest with the chin tucked. The back rises to the surface. Hold for a few seconds.

short.q: Explain why it is dangerous for a child to jump into a river to rescue someone.
short.answer: The child may also drown because water can be deep or fast. It is safer to shout for an adult and throw something that floats.
short.working: 1 mark for the danger, 2 marks for the safe action.

short.q: Describe how to do the frog jump.
short.answer: Squat with hands on the ground. Spring forward with the legs. Land softly on toes and hands with bent knees.

short.q: Give four safety rules for animal games.
short.answer: Play on soft, clear ground; warm up; keep a distance from others; do not push or trip; drink water; follow the whistle. Any four.

short.q: How can an elder help you to learn indigenous games?
short.answer: The elder can teach you the games and songs of the community and share their stories.

short.q: How should you receive feedback from others?
short.answer: Listen quietly, do not argue, say thank you and think about the ideas.

short.q: State the role of the Kenya National Anthem.
short.answer: It is a national symbol that unites Kenyans, shows love for the country and reminds us of our values.

short.q: Describe the roles of the soloist, the chorus and the instrumentalists in a folk song.
short.answer: The soloist leads, the chorus answers and repeats, the instrumentalists play instruments to keep the beat.
